note: On the basis of cuticular hydrocarbon gas chromatography and morphology the author synonymizes G. kushimensis Mori, 1978 and G. kodamai Mori, 1976 with this species; measurement abbreviations: HL head length, HW head width, LL labrum length, LW labrum width, HH head height, PnL pronotum length, PnW pronotum width, LML left mandible length, PmL postmentum length, PmW1/PmW2 maximum/minimum postmentum width.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier head resembles that of the Japanese Neotermes koshunensis, but the soldier of this species is distinguished by the distinct anterolateral projections of the head, antennal segment 3 smaller than the adjacent segments, and the distinctly swollen mesepimeron. The species often nests in the trunks of living trees and swarms at dusk in June—July (months 6—7); individuals from the same nest vary greatly in size. Distribution: Japan (Kochi, Miyazaki and Kagoshima Prefectures, and Nakanoshima), Taiwan, southern China.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head capsule dark brown; antennae and mandibles pale brown, the teeth darker; pronotum dark brown like the head; rest of the body brown; wing membrane brown and transparent, the veins dark brown; legs pale brown, tibiae and tarsi paler. Head capsule oval, scattered with hairs; head index 0.94—0.98. Compound eyes large, slightly longer than wide, diameter 0.29—0.30 mm; compound eye index 0.46—0.51. Ocelli distinct, about one third of the diameter of the compound eye. Antennae 11—13-segmented. Anterior margin of the labrum with several long hairs, the anterior surface with numerous short hairs. Apical tooth of the left mandible longer than the first and second marginal teeth together; the posterior margin of the first and second marginal teeth longer than their anterior margin and the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth; the base of the posterior margin of the first and second marginal teeth with a weak notch. Apical tooth of the right mandible as long as the first marginal tooth; posterior margin of the second marginal tooth almost as long as the molar plate. Postmentum rectangular, distinctly longer than wide, the sides converging forwards, the posterior margin convex, the surface with numerous short hairs and several long hairs, the lateral margins more densely haired. Pronotum simple and flat, as wide as the head, the anterior margin slightly concave without a notch, the posterior margin slightly concave; the disc with several short hairs and a few long hairs, the margins with numerous long and short hairs. Forewing length 6.80—7.10 mm; the radius meets the costal margin at one third of the anterior wing margin; the radial sector is unbranched, parallel to the costal margin, and bears several weak cross-veins to the costal margin on its distal half; the media lies close and parallel to the radial sector and reaches the wing apex, with several weak cross-veins to the radial sector on its distal half; the cubitus is weak and unsclerotized, with 8—10 branches to the posterior margin. Hindwing slightly shorter than the forewing; the media arises at the anterior fifth of the radial sector, lies close to the radial sector and reaches the wing apex; the cubitus is weak and unsclerotized, with 6—7 branches to the posterior margin. Femoral-tibial index 0.79—0.81; tibial spur formula 3:3:3.

Measurements (20 individuals, mm, range/mean): head length 0.96—1.01 (0.99); head width 1.03—1.05 (1.04); labrum length 0.28—0.32 (0.30); labrum width 0.35—0.40 (0.36); head height 0.59—0.63 (0.60); pronotum length 0.55—0.60 (0.58); pronotum width 0.95—1.04 (1.00).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule brownish yellow, darker anteriorly; antennae, labrum and clypeus brownish yellow like the head; mandibles dark brown; thorax and abdomen pale brownish yellow. Head capsule long, nearly rectangular, the sides parallel, without anterolateral lobes at the mandibular base, sparsely covered with long and short hairs; head index 1.14—1.46; frontal region sloping gradually; coronal and frontal sutures distinct. Antennae 10—13-segmented. Labrum as long as wide, the anterior margin rounded, the sides parallel, the anterior margin with several long hairs and the surface with several short hairs. Mandibles short and stout, slightly raised at the base, densely covered with short hairs; mandibular index 0.51—0.64. The anterior and posterior bases of the second marginal tooth of the left mandible each bear a distinct notch; the anterior and posterior bases of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible each bear a distinct notch, and the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth is distinctly longer than its anterior margin. Postmentum long, club-shaped; the anterior half concave on both sides, widest at one third from the front, the surface with several short and long hairs; the posterior half narrowest, the sides parallel, hairless. Pronotum flat, as wide as the head, the anterior margin concave without a notch, the surface with several hairs, the margins with numerous long hairs. Femoral-tibial index 0.83—0.90; tibial spur formula 3:3:3.

Measurements (20 individuals, mm, range/mean): head length 1.95—2.80 (2.37); head width 1.40—1.92 (1.75); left mandible length 1.00—1.30 (1.22); labrum length 0.29—0.48 (0.35); labrum width 0.38—0.55 (0.51); head height 1.23—1.73 (1.50); postmentum length 1.60—2.63 (2.04); maximum postmentum width 0.49—0.60 (0.56); minimum postmentum width 0.20—0.30 (0.27); pronotum length 0.65—1.06 (0.89); pronotum width 1.32—1.85 (1.68).
